requirements_summary: Workload: mixed chat + embeddings + reranking. Targets: 95th pctile <= 350ms for chat, sustained throughput ~60 QPS for rerank during peak, average cost sensitivity: high (target <$0.02 per active user/month). Model prefs: prefer small-to-medium open LLMs for reranking, allow Redwood-curated variants. Routing: need policy to route lowest-cost compatible model under non-critical SLAs. Data: customer logs retained 30d, PII redaction required, regional residency US only.
poc_plan: POC scope: 6-week evaluation. Week1: hosted API baseline (latency/cost/per-token). Week2-4: integrate prefix caching + KV cache for chat; run A/B with caching enabled. Week3: rerank pipeline bench with batching. Week4-5: evaluate quantized model variants on dedicated nodes (if provisioned). Week6: present final unit economics and recommended commit sizes.
cost_workshop_notes: Workshop goals: expose unit economics, quantify batching/caching impact, show Dedicated vs Hosted run-rate. Findings from workshop draft: - Batching: continuous batching for reranker reduces per-request GPU time ~25-35% at 40-100ms batching window. - Caching: prefix/KV caching for chat reduces token generation by up to 30% on repeat flows (support scenarios). - Quantization: int8/4-bit profiles reduce memory footprint 2-3x and lower cost per token for Dedicated by ~20-45% depending on model. - Combined: expected token-cost reduction 40%-55% in steady-state for their hybrid workload. Action: run bench with customer dataset to validate 40% case.
